newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: S&P assigns BBB rating to Westralia Airports Corp.
newsitem.headline: S&P assigns BBB rating to Westralia Airports Corp.

text.p: Standard and Poor's Corp said on Tuesday it has assigned its BBB long term and A-3 long-term issuer credit ratings to Westralia Airports Corporation Pty Ltd.

S&P said the rating reflected the strong business and operating profile of the Perth airport which was offset by moderate financial coverages and significant capitalisation of debt. "The rating outlook is stable, reflecting the conservative financial forecasts of the ariport as well as the growing debt burden," S&P said.
Perth Airport is the only international and domestic airport serving Perth, the capital of Western Australia.
Westralia took over the operation of the airport from the government-owned Federal Airports Corp on July 2, and was awarded a 50-year lease with an option to extend for 49 years.
S&P said Perth airport has a diversified revenue base and relatively unrestricted operation conditiosn.

It said that in accordance with the anticipated passenger growth of about five percent a year and aircraft movements of 3.7 percent year over the next 10 years, Westralia has significant opportunities to increase revenue leves.
